nodes.description: uint128 counter incremented on each registration; global user id tracker.
uint128 accumulator of ETH received for registrations and level upgrades.
Immutable contract owner address used for privileged checks and matrix termination.
Immutable Uniswap V2 pair address used to read reserves for the burn fee.
Immutable ERC20 token (SDCP) address used for transferFrom burn fee payments.
Immutable address receiving burned tokens.
Mapping of address to User struct holding referrer, partners and X3/X6 matrix state.
Mapping of level to ETH price, doubling from 0.025 ether up to LAST_LEVEL.
Constant maximum matrix level (12).
Deploys contract, stores owner/pair/token/pool, validates SDCP pairing and seeds level prices.
Owner-only function activating all X3/X6 levels for a list of team addresses.
Payable entry point registering msg.sender under a referrer.
Payable upgrade of an X3 or X6 matrix level, charging burn fee and rewiring referrers.
Reads V2 reserves and computes the SDCP burn fee proportional to ETH value.
Pulls SDCP from a user to the pool via transferFrom inside a try/catch.
Private registration routine validating cost/referrer, charging burn fee and placing user in both matrices.
Pushes a user into X3 referrals and pays dividends or triggers resetX3 at 3 referrals.
Recycles a full X3 matrix slot, burning fees and re-placing the referrer; terminates at owner.
Complex X6 placement logic building first/second level referrals and closed parts.
Places a user under the first or second X6 first-level referral depending on the x2 flag.
Handles second level X6 referral accounting and triggers resetX6 when full.
Recycles a full X6 matrix, charging burn fee and re-placing the referrer; terminates at owner.
Walks the referral chain upward to find the first user with the X3 level active.
Walks the referral chain upward to find the first user with the X6 level active.
Public view returning the X3 matrix state of a user at a level.
Public view returning the X6 matrix state of a user at a level.
Public view returning referrer, partnersCount, useIds and ethAmounts.
Internal check that an address is the owner or has a non-zero referrer.
Walks blocked matrix slots to find the effective ETH dividend receiver, flagging extra dividends.
Resolves the receiver and sends levelPrice ETH with send(), falling back to transfer of full balance.
Caller-controlled address used for registration, upgrades and ownership checks.
payable(receiver).send(levelPrice[level]) low-level external ETH send.
payable(receiver).transfer(address(this).balance) fallback draining contract balance.
External ISDCP.transferFrom call on an arbitrary token address inside try/catch.
Inline assembly extcodesize check on the registering address.
useIds += 1 increment of a packed uint128 state variable.
ethAmounts += uint128(levelPrice[level]) packed state variable arithmetic.
levelPrice[i] = levelPrice[i-1] * 2 arithmetic in constructor.
External IV2Pair.getReserves() call whose values drive fee computation.
Referrer address supplied to join().
Matrix selector (1 = X3, 2 = X6) for buyNewLevel.
Level being purchased in buyNewLevel.
Address being registered in registration().
ETH value converted into burn fee in calcBurnFee.
User whose SDCP is pulled in burnFee.
SDCP amount to pull in burnFee.
Array of addresses to activate levels for in upTeam.
User being placed in the X3 matrix.
Referrer receiving the X3 placement.
X3 matrix level being updated.
Initial candidate receiver in sendETHDividends.
Level whose price is paid in sendETHDividends.
Boolean selecting first or second X6 first-level referral in updateX6.
Burn fee computed for the purchased level in buyNewLevel.
extcodesize result for the registering address in registration.
Resolved free X3 referrer in buyNewLevel.
Resolved free X6 referrer in buyNewLevel.
New free referrer computed during X3 reset.
Final ETH receiver resolved by findEthReceiver.
Flag marking that blocked slots caused extra dividends.
Length of the second level referrer first-level referral array in updateX6Referrer.

edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the registering user address to join/registration.
msg.sender drives all matrix reads and writes in buyNewLevel.
upTeam requires msg.sender to equal the owner address.
msg.sender becomes userAddress in the private registration routine.
referrerAddress parameter flows into join.
matrix parameter selects the X3 or X6 branch.
level parameter indexes levelPrice and matrix mappings.
userAddress parameter is registered into users mapping.
value parameter is scaled by reserves to compute the burn fee.
user parameter is the transferFrom sender.
brunAmount parameter is the transferFrom amount.
team array elements have their X3/X6 levels activated.
userAddress is pushed into the referrer's X3 referral array.
referrerAddress is the storage target of updateX3Referrer.
level indexes the X3 matrix mapping.
userAddress seeds the receiver search in sendETHDividends.
level selects the ETH price paid out.
x2 boolean chooses which first level referral receives the placement.
locally computed fee is passed to burnFee in buyNewLevel.
size is produced by the inline assembly extcodesize.
freeX3Referrer is returned by findFreeX3Referrer.
freeX6Referrer is returned by findFreeX6Referrer.
freeReferrerAddress is returned by findFreeX3Referrer during reset.
receiver is returned by findEthReceiver.
isExtraDividends is returned by findEthReceiver.
len measures the referrer's referral array length in updateX6Referrer.
isUserExists reads the users mapping referrer field.
findFreeX3Referrer traverses users referrer and level flags.
findFreeX6Referrer traverses users referrer and level flags.
findEthReceiver walks blocked matrix slots in users.
updateX3Referrer mutates users X3 matrix structures.
resetX3 clears and rewires X3 matrix state in users.
updateX6Referrer mutates users X6 matrix structures.
updateX6ReferrerSecondLevel reads and writes closedPart state.
resetX6 clears and rewires X6 matrix state in users.
buyNewLevel requires msg.value to equal levelPrice[level].
calcBurnFee receives levelPrice values that are converted to burn amounts.
resetX3 charges calcBurnFee on levelPrice[level].
resetX6 charges calcBurnFee on levelPrice[level].
sendETHDividends pays out levelPrice[level].
calcBurnFee reads reserves from the v2Pair address.
calcBurnFee compares token0 to the sdcpToken address.
burnFee calls transferFrom on the sdcpToken address.
burnFee transfers burned tokens to the pool address.
upTeam compares the caller against the owner address.
resetX3 branches on referrerAddress != owner.
updateX6Referrer returns early when referrerAddress == owner.
resetX6 branches on referrerAddress != owner.
buyNewLevel bounds the level by LAST_LEVEL.
constructor loops levels up to LAST_LEVEL.
constructor stores the owner address.
constructor stores the sdcpToken address.
constructor stores the v2Pair address.
constructor stores the pool address.
constructor initializes levelPrice entries.
constructor seeds the owner user record in users.
usersStatus returns the useIds counter.
usersStatus returns the ethAmounts accumulator.
buyNewLevel adds the level price to the packed ethAmounts counter.
registration increments the packed useIds counter.
registration increments the packed ethAmounts counter.
join delegates directly to registration.
registration validates user and referrer existence via isUserExists.
registration computes the burn fee with calcBurnFee.
registration enforces burnFee payment before state writes.
registration finds the free X3 referrer.
registration finds the free X6 referrer.
registration places the new user via updateX3Referrer.
registration places the new user via updateX6Referrer.
buyNewLevel requires the caller to be a registered user.
buyNewLevel computes the burn fee for the purchased level.
buyNewLevel enforces burnFee payment.
buyNewLevel resolves the free X3 referrer.
buyNewLevel resolves the free X6 referrer.
buyNewLevel updates the X3 referrer chain.
buyNewLevel updates the X6 referrer chain.
updateX3Referrer pays dividends when referrals length is below three.
updateX3Referrer calls resetX3 when the X3 slot is full.
resetX3 recomputes the burn fee.
resetX3 charges the referrer a burn fee.
resetX3 finds a new free X3 referrer.
resetX3 pays dividends when the referrer is the owner.
resetX3 recursively re-places the referrer via updateX3Referrer.
updateX6Referrer pays dividends on placement.
updateX6Referrer delegates placements to updateX6.
updateX6Referrer continues with second level processing.
updateX6ReferrerSecondLevel pays dividends while second level is incomplete.
updateX6ReferrerSecondLevel calls resetX6 when the matrix is full.
resetX6 recomputes the burn fee.
resetX6 charges the referrer a burn fee.
resetX6 finds a new free X6 referrer.
resetX6 pays dividends when the referrer is the owner.
resetX6 recursively re-places the referrer via updateX6Referrer.
sendETHDividends resolves the receiver through findEthReceiver.
burnFee invokes the external transferFrom unsafe operation.
calcBurnFee performs the external getReserves call.
registration executes the inline assembly extcodesize check.
registration increments the packed useIds counter.
buyNewLevel increments the packed ethAmounts counter.
constructor doubles levelPrice each iteration.
sendETHDividends performs an external ETH send to a caller-influenced receiver.
sendETHDividends falls back to transferring the whole contract balance.
The low-level send forwards gas allowing the receiver to re-enter dividend payout logic.
The receiver of send() can re-enter buyNewLevel before outer accounting completes.
transfer fallback drains balance and can interact with buyNewLevel while state is being updated.
Re-entrant calls triggered by send() can mutate the users mapping mid-flow.

normalization_plan.reason: Referrer argument is only consumed by join before delegating to registration.
Matrix selector is only meaningful inside buyNewLevel's branch.
Level index is scoped to the buyNewLevel transaction.
Registered address is bound to the private registration routine.
ETH value is consumed only by the fee computation.
Sender address is only used by the burnFee transferFrom.
Transfer amount is only used by the burnFee transferFrom.
Team array is only iterated inside upTeam.
Placed user is only used within the X3 update routine.
Referrer target is only used within the X3 update routine.
Level index is only used within the X3 update routine.
Initial receiver candidate is only used by the payout routine.
Level selects the payout amount inside sendETHDividends.
Branch flag is only consumed by updateX6 placement logic.
Computed fee is immediately forwarded to the burnFee call.
size is the direct output of the extcodesize unsafe operation.
freeX3Referrer is the direct return of findFreeX3Referrer.
freeX6Referrer is the direct return of findFreeX6Referrer.
freeReferrerAddress is computed and consumed solely within resetX3.
receiver is the direct return value of findEthReceiver.
isExtraDividends is the direct return value of findEthReceiver.
len is a temporary array length used only inside updateX6Referrer.
